title: Portfolio Project
description: One real, named project for scripts/intelligence/application_strategy.py's portfolio_recommendation() to match against a job's requirements. This repository ships NO real entries — see config/portfolio_projects.example.yaml for the structure and profile/profile.md for how to add your own. Every field is optional except name/project_types; leave a field out rather than guessing at it.

name.description: A short, real project name/identifier — never invented.

project_types.description: Must match categories used in config/profile_skills.yaml's project_types list (Residential, Luxury Villas, Commercial, ...).

area_sqm.description: Gross floor area in square meters, if relevant and known.

role.description: Your actual role on the project, e.g. 'BIM Coordinator', 'Lead Architect'.

software.description: Tools actually used on this project.

disciplines.description: e.g. Architecture, Structure, MEP — disciplines actually coordinated on this project.

scope.description: Which of your own scopes applied to this project — only mark true what you actually did.

achievements.description: Measurable outcomes only, e.g. 'Reduced clash-detection rework by coordinating 4 disciplines in ACC' — never a vague or invented claim.

source_url.description: The external page this project's facts were taken from, if any.

source_retrieved_at.description: ISO timestamp of when source_url was actually fetched/confirmed — null if not independently verified yet.

evidence_status.description: How confidently this record's facts are confirmed: VERIFIED (independently fetched/confirmed), PARTIAL (asserted by a trusted source but not independently re-verified), UNKNOWN.

evidence_notes.description: Free-text caveats about this record's provenance, e.g. why it is PARTIAL rather than VERIFIED.

visual_evidence_status.description: Whether any photos/renders associated with this project on its source are confirmed photography of this exact project (CONFIRMED), explicitly representative/sample imagery only (REPRESENTATIVE), or not established (UNKNOWN). Never treat REPRESENTATIVE or UNKNOWN visuals as proof of this project's actual appearance.
